value.rationale: Counterexamples with higher-degree symmetric generators motivate finding the exact first complexity level where interior OPA zeros are impossible. The all-alpha sharp universal exclusion radius, exact one-circle of optimizing zero-free generators and nontrivial change with alpha identify a genuine structural boundary, not merely restate elementary zero-freeness. No downstream theorem is required for this motivated exact cutoff.
